title: WP-ARCH-A: badf-architecture capability contract freeze (DESIGN/ASSURE, DESIGNED only, no G04 authority change)
objective: Freeze the badf-architecture capability contract at DESIGNED -- analogous to the badf-research freeze (WP-0031). Ship skills/badf-architecture/SKILL.md + references/ (DESIGN/ASSURE, canonical model vs diagram, C4-as-views, ADR vs BADF-DEC, NFR allocation, fitness obligations, G04 mapping, external methodology, acceptance), a registry entry DESIGNED with a real digest, and a doc-structural contract test. No executable, no schemas, no gate code, no G04 authority change.
business_value: Establishes architecture as an engineering + assurance capability (not a diagram skill) before G04 enforcement is built, so the later G04 gate contract and the ASSURE substrate have a frozen, machine-referenceable meaning to implement against -- and so C4 stays a view, never the architecture source of truth.
in_scope: skills/badf-architecture/SKILL.md (concise, declarative; DESIGN/ASSURE modes; authority boundary; routing)
the twelve invariants ARCH-I01..ARCH-I12 stated verbatim
badf/skill-registry.json entry: badf-architecture DESIGNED, allowed_tools [], real digest
doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: WP-ARCH-B: deterministic G04 DESIGN evidence semantics inside the canonical gate (schemas + check_* rules)
WP-ARCH-C: the ASSURE substrate (dependency graph, cycles, boundary rules, ADR compliance, baseline/observed binding)
any change to G04 in lifecycle.json or any G04 authority
any scripts/badf_architecture.py executable (ARCH-I11: no second gate)
acceptance_criteria: skills/badf-architecture/SKILL.md exists, is concise, names every reference, and states the fundamental rule + authority boundary (does not approve G04, does not advance lifecycle)
the DESIGN and ASSURE modes and the canonical-model-vs-diagram distinction are documented
ARCH-I01..ARCH-I12 are stated verbatim in the references
g04-contract.md maps all five G04 evidence types (architecture/adr/data-model/api-contract/operability-design)
the registry entry is DESIGNED and its digest == sha256(SKILL.md); `repo` passes
no scripts/*architecture* executable exists; 'architecture' is not in EVIDENCE_RULES (still DESIGNED, not IMPLEMENTED)
compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Docs + registry only -- no new gate branch, so mutation is N/A; the contract test guards the meaning. Mirrors the badf-research freeze WP-0031 (C2/G07).
